name: oh-my-pi
description: Runs a terminal coding agent forked from Pi with language servers, debuggers, subagents, and code review built in, usable as a TUI, one-shot command, Node SDK, RPC, or ACP server.

skills.name: LSP-Aware Edits
skills.description: Routes renames and writes through language servers, so re-exports, barrel files, and aliased imports update before a file moves.

skills.name: Debugger Sessions
skills.description: Attaches real debuggers such as lldb, dlv, and debugpy to step through a crash or hang, read frames, and inspect variables.

skills.name: Typed Subagents
skills.description: Fans a task out to subagents in isolated worktrees, each with its own tools, and returns a schema-validated object to the parent.

skills.name: Prioritized Code Review
skills.description: Spawns reviewer subagents with /review over a branch, commit, or uncommitted work, ranking issues P0 to P3 with a ship verdict.

skills.name: SDK, RPC, And ACP
skills.description: Embeds the agent in Node through its SDK, drives it over NDJSON RPC on stdio, or connects it to editors with the Agent Client Protocol.
